_about: Public-domain Phineas D. Gurley (1816-1868), pastor of the New York Avenue Presbyterian Church in Washington, where Abraham Lincoln worshipped, and chaplain of the Senate, for the Word Hoard: his funeral sermons for Willie Lincoln and for the President, Incentives to Duty in the Work of Missions, Man's Projects and God's Results, The Voice of the Rod, and a funeral sermon for Harriet McGuffey. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 107 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
